name: Jitters Joint
source:
Congrats! You’ve got a job at Jitters Joint.

At first, the café seems like any other… until you start noticing the people acting strangely. Can you figure out what’s really going on, or is it all in your mind?

[From [url=https://evisceratt.itch.io/jitters-joint-average]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
恭喜！你在Jitters Joint找到了一份工作。

起初，这家咖啡馆看起来和其他咖啡馆没什么两样……直到你开始注意到人们的行为很奇怪。你能弄清楚到底发生了什么，还是这一切都在你的脑海里？
